mapper.sql: a.approval_id, a.doc_no, a.doc_type, a.title, a.content, a.drafter_id, a.dept_id, a.amount, a.status, a.current_step, a.drafted_at, a.submitted_at, a.completed_at, e.emp_name AS drafter_name, p.position_name AS drafter_position_name, d.dept_name
FROM approval_doc a JOIN employee e ON e.emp_id = a.drafter_id JOIN position p ON p.position_id = e.position_id JOIN department d ON d.dept_id = a.dept_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_doc (doc_no, doc_type, title, content, drafter_id, dept_id, amount, status, current_step, drafted_at, submitted_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{docNo}, #{docType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{drafterId}, #{deptId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{currentStep}, #{draftedAt}, #{submittedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(a.doc_no FROM 10 FOR 4) AS INT)), 0) FROM approval_doc a WHERE a.doc_no LIKE #{prefix} || '-' || CAST(#{year} AS VARCHAR(4)) || '-%'

choose.when: a.status = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_line l WHERE l.approval_id = a.approval_id AND l.approver_id = #{empId} AND l.status = 'CURRENT')
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_line l WHERE l.approval_id = a.approval_id AND l.approver_id = #{empId} AND l.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))

where.if: AND (a.title LIKE '%' || #{keywordEscaped} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR a.doc_no LIKE '%' || #{keywordEscaped} || '%' ESCAPE '\')

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.drafter_id = #{empId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS drafted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_line l WHERE l.approval_id = a.approval_id AND l.approver_id = #{empId} AND l.status = 'CURRENT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_line l WHERE l.approval_id = a.approval_id AND l.approver_id = #{empId} AND l.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS done, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.drafter_id = #{empId} AND a.status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected FROM approval_doc a
